subject: gov.protect
name: Prosecutions under the cybersecurity and data-protection law

position_end: A court of first instance convicted an activist, entrepreneur and school founder of insult and defamation by means of a computer system on 19 August 2026, sentencing him to six months' imprisonment of which five are suspended and a 40 million GNF fine, and ordering the deletion of his Facebook account; the conviction rests on article 363 of the penal code and article 29 of the cybersecurity and personal-data protection law.
